verdict: Leads and efficiency up this week; spend pullback now threatens to reverse both.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 125 leads from Meta at an average cost of $11.80 per lead — and this past week that cost dropped another 20%, meaning the same budget is buying more. The problem is the budget itself: daily spend fell sharply over the last three days, and lead volume followed, dropping from as many as 8 per day to as few as 1. Google Business Profile activity also fell by more than half week-over-week, meaning organic discovery is contracting at the same time paid spend is pulling back — a compounding risk heading into month-end. Spend levels are being stabilised now to protect the volume gains already made. Appointment-booking tracking is also being repaired so next period's report can show the full picture from lead to booked patient.

watch_item.fix: Spend floors are being set to hold daily budget at a level that sustains lead volume through the end of August.
